<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_2056099_indust_0.ProductionScheduler</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Server-side utility for creating draft Production Schedules. Validates PO and Resource, checks capacity, prevents duplicates and overlaps, creates DRAFT schedule.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>ProductionScheduler</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * ProductionScheduler
 *
 * Server-side utility for creating draft Production Schedules.
 * Validates prerequisites (PO, materials, resource, time slot,
 * delivery date) and creates a DRAFT schedule entry.
 * Supports priority-aware batch scheduling.
 *
 * Usage (single):
 *   var scheduler = new x_2056099_indust_0.ProductionScheduler();
 *   var result = scheduler.createDraftSchedule('po_sys_id');
 *
 * Usage (batch, priority-ordered):
 *   var results = scheduler.scheduleBatch(['po1', 'po2', 'po3']);
 */
var ProductionScheduler = Class.create();
ProductionScheduler.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.PO_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_production_order';
        this.RES_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_prod_res';
        this.SCHED_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_prod_sched';
        this.PM_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_production_material';
        this.STOCK_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock';
        this.CO_TABLE = 'x_2056099_indust_0_cust_order';
        this.PRIORITY_RANK = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 };
    },

    /**
     * Schedules multiple Production Orders in priority order.
     * Higher-priority POs are scheduled first and get the earliest slots.
     * Each PO goes through the full feasibility pipeline.
     *
     * @param {string[]} poSysIds - array of Production Order sys_ids
     * @returns {object} { scheduled[], failed[], summary }
     */
    scheduleBatch: function (poSysIds) {
        if (!poSysIds || poSysIds.length === 0) {
            return { scheduled: [], failed: [], summary: 'No Production Orders provided' };
        }

        // Load PO priorities for sorting
        var self = this;
        var entries = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < poSysIds.length; i++) {
            var poGr = new GlideRecord(this.PO_TABLE);
            if (poGr.get(poSysIds[i])) {
                entries.push({
                    sys_id: poSysIds[i],
                    priority: poGr.getValue('priority') || 'medium',
                    rank: this._getPriorityRank(poGr.getValue('priority'))
                });
            } else {
                entries.push({
                    sys_id: poSysIds[i],
                    priority: 'unknown',
                    rank: 99
                });
            }
        }

        // Sort by priority rank (lower = higher priority = scheduled first)
        // Stable sort: preserve original order for same priority
        entries.sort(function (a, b) {
            return a.rank - b.rank;
        });

        var scheduled = [];
        var failed = [];

        for (var j = 0; j < entries.length; j++) {
            var entry = entries[j];
            var result = this.createDraftSchedule(entry.sys_id);
            var item = {
                sys_id: entry.sys_id,
                priority: entry.priority,
                order: j + 1
            };

            if (result.success) {
                item.schedule_id = result.schedule_id;
                item.message = result.message;
                item.planned_start = result.details.planned_start;
                item.planned_end = result.details.planned_end;
                item.resource = result.details.resource;
                scheduled.push(item);
            } else {
                item.error = result.error;
                failed.push(item);
            }
        }

        return {
            scheduled: scheduled,
            failed: failed,
            summary: 'Batch complete. Scheduled: ' + scheduled.length + ', Failed: ' + failed.length + ' of ' + entries.length + ' total. Order: ' + entries.map(function (e) { return e.priority; }).join(' → ')
        };
    },

    /**
     * Returns numeric rank for a priority value (lower = higher priority).
     * @param {string} priority
     * @returns {number}
     */
    _getPriorityRank: function (priority) {
        var rank = this.PRIORITY_RANK[priority];
        return (rank !== undefined) ? rank : 99;
    },

    /**
     * Creates a draft Production Schedule for the given Production Order.
     * @param {string} poSysId - sys_id of the Production Order
     * @returns {object} { success, schedule_id, message, error, details }
     */
    createDraftSchedule: function (poSysId) {
        if (!poSysId) {
            return this._fail('Production Order sys_id is required');
        }

        // --- 1. Load and validate Production Order ---
        var po = new GlideRecord(this.PO_TABLE);
        if (!po.get(poSysId)) {
            return this._fail('Production Order not found');
        }
        if (po.getValue('active') != '1') {
            return this._fail('Production Order is inactive');
        }
        var poStatus = po.getValue('status');
        if (poStatus == 'completed' || poStatus == 'cancelled') {
            return this._fail('Production Order is ' + po.getDisplayValue('status') + ' and cannot be scheduled');
        }
        var planned = parseFloat(po.getValue('quantity_planned')) || 0;
        if (planned <= 0) {
            return this._fail('Production Order has no planned quantity');
        }
        var requiredPerDay = parseFloat(po.getValue('required_capacity_per_day')) || 0;

        // --- 2. Check for existing active schedule on this PO ---
        var existCheck = new GlideRecord(this.SCHED_TABLE);
        existCheck.addQuery('production_order', poSysId);
        existCheck.addQuery('active', true);
        existCheck.addQuery('status', 'IN', 'draft,scheduled,confirmed');
        existCheck.setLimit(1);
        existCheck.query();
        if (existCheck.hasNext()) {
            existCheck.next();
            return this._fail('Production Order already has an active schedule (status: ' + existCheck.getDisplayValue('status') + ', sys_id: ' + existCheck.getValue('sys_id') + ')');
        }

        // --- 2b. Check material feasibility ---
        var materialCheck = this._checkMaterialFeasibility(poSysId);
        if (!materialCheck.feasible) {
            return this._fail(materialCheck.reason);
        }

        // --- 3. Select a feasible resource ---
        var selection = this._selectResource(po, planned, requiredPerDay);
        if (!selection.success) {
            return this._fail(selection.error);
        }

        var selectedRes = selection.resource;
        var resId = selectedRes.sys_id;
        var resName = selectedRes.name;
        var capacityPerDay = selectedRes.capacity;
        var schedStart = selection.planned_start;
        var schedEnd = selection.planned_end;
        var daysNeeded = selection.days_needed;

        // --- 3b. Check delivery date feasibility ---
        var deliveryCheck = this._checkDeliveryFeasibility(po, schedEnd);
        if (!deliveryCheck.feasible) {
            return this._fail(deliveryCheck.reason);
        }

        // --- 4. Create the draft schedule ---
        var sched = new GlideRecord(this.SCHED_TABLE);
        sched.initialize();
        sched.setValue('production_order', poSysId);
        sched.setValue('production_resource', resId);
        sched.setValue('planned_start', schedStart.getValue());
        sched.setValue('planned_end', schedEnd.getValue());
        sched.setValue('planned_quantity', planned.toString());
        sched.setValue('priority', po.getValue('priority') || 'medium');
        sched.setValue('status', 'draft');
        sched.setValue('active', true);
        var note = 'Auto-scheduled on "' + resName + '". ' + daysNeeded + ' day(s) at ' + capacityPerDay + ' units/day.';
        if (selection.was_fallback) {
            note += ' (Fallback: assigned resource was not feasible.)';
        }
        if (materialCheck.materials_checked > 0) {
            note += ' Materials checked: ' + materialCheck.materials_checked + ' item(s) feasible.';
        }
        if (deliveryCheck.delivery_date_display) {
            note += ' Delivery by: ' + deliveryCheck.delivery_date_display + '.';
        }
        sched.setValue('notes', note);
        var schedId = sched.insert();

        if (!schedId) {
            return this._fail('Failed to create schedule record');
        }

        return {
            success: true,
            schedule_id: schedId,
            message: 'Draft schedule created. ' + planned + ' units over ' + daysNeeded + ' day(s) on "' + resName + '".' + (selection.was_fallback ? ' (Fallback resource used.)' : ''),
            details: {
                planned_start: schedStart.getDisplayValue(),
                planned_end: schedEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                planned_quantity: planned,
                days_needed: daysNeeded,
                capacity_per_day: capacityPerDay,
                priority: po.getValue('priority') || 'medium',
                resource: resName,
                resource_sys_id: resId,
                was_fallback: selection.was_fallback,
                materials_checked: materialCheck.materials_checked,
                delivery_date: deliveryCheck.delivery_date_display || null,
                delivery_source: deliveryCheck.source || null
            }
        };
    },

    /**
     * Checks whether the proposed schedule end date meets the delivery deadline.
     */
    _checkDeliveryFeasibility: function (po, proposedEnd) {
        var deliveryDate = null;
        var source = '';

        var coId = po.getValue('customer_order');
        if (coId) {
            var co = new GlideRecord(this.CO_TABLE);
            if (co.get(coId)) {
                var reqDel = co.getValue('requested_delivery_date');
                if (reqDel) {
                    deliveryDate = new GlideDateTime(reqDel);
                    source = 'customer_order.requested_delivery_date';
                }
            }
        }

        if (!deliveryDate) {
            var poEnd = po.getValue('planned_end_date');
            if (poEnd) {
                deliveryDate = new GlideDateTime(poEnd);
                source = 'production_order.planned_end_date';
            }
        }

        if (!deliveryDate) {
            return { feasible: true, source: 'none', delivery_date_display: null };
        }

        var deliveryDisplay = deliveryDate.getDisplayValue();

        if (proposedEnd.compareTo(deliveryDate) <= 0) {
            return { feasible: true, source: source, delivery_date_display: deliveryDisplay };
        }

        var delayMs = GlideDateTime.subtract(deliveryDate, proposedEnd).getNumericValue();
        var delayDays = Math.ceil(delayMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

        return {
            feasible: false,
            reason: 'Schedule would miss delivery date. Proposed end: ' + proposedEnd.getDisplayValue() + ', Required delivery: ' + deliveryDisplay + ' (from ' + source + '). Delay: ' + delayDays + ' day(s).',
            source: source,
            delivery_date_display: deliveryDisplay
        };
    },

    /**
     * Checks whether all active material requirements for a PO
     * can be satisfied by available inventory stock.
     */
    _checkMaterialFeasibility: function (poSysId) {
        var pmGr = new GlideRecord(this.PM_TABLE);
        pmGr.addQuery('production_order', poSysId);
        pmGr.addQuery('active', true);
        pmGr.query();

        var shortages = [];
        var checked = 0;

        while (pmGr.next()) {
            checked++;
            var materialId = pmGr.getValue('material_product');
            var materialName = pmGr.getDisplayValue('material_product');
            var required = parseFloat(pmGr.getValue('required_quantity')) || 0;

            if (required <= 0) {
                continue;
            }

            var stockGa = new GlideAggregate(this.STOCK_TABLE);
            stockGa.addQuery('material_product', materialId);
            stockGa.addQuery('active', true);
            stockGa.addQuery('status', 'available');
            stockGa.addAggregate('SUM', 'available_quantity');
            stockGa.query();

            var available = 0;
            if (stockGa.next()) {
                available = parseFloat(stockGa.getAggregate('SUM', 'available_quantity')) || 0;
            }

            if (available < required) {
                shortages.push({
                    material: materialName,
                    required: required,
                    available: available,
                    deficit: required - available
                });
            }
        }

        if (shortages.length > 0) {
            var msgs = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < shortages.length; i++) {
                var s = shortages[i];
                msgs.push(s.material + ': required ' + s.required + ', available ' + s.available + ' (deficit: ' + s.deficit + ')');
            }
            return {
                feasible: false,
                reason: 'Material shortage for ' + shortages.length + ' item(s): ' + msgs.join('; '),
                shortages: shortages,
                materials_checked: checked
            };
        }

        return { feasible: true, materials_checked: checked };
    },

    /**
     * Selects the best feasible resource for the PO.
     */
    _selectResource: function (po, planned, requiredPerDay) {
        var assignedResId = po.getValue('assigned_resource');

        if (assignedResId) {
            var assignedResult = this._evaluateResource(assignedResId, planned, requiredPerDay, po);
            if (assignedResult.feasible) {
                return { success: true, resource: assignedResult.resource, planned_start: assignedResult.planned_start, planned_end: assignedResult.planned_end, days_needed: assignedResult.days_needed, was_fallback: false };
            }
        }

        var candidates = [];
        var resGr = new GlideRecord(this.RES_TABLE);
        resGr.addQuery('active', true);
        resGr.addQuery('status', 'available');
        resGr.addQuery('maintenance_required', false);
        resGr.addQuery('capacity_per_day', '>', 0);
        resGr.query();

        while (resGr.next()) {
            var resSysId = resGr.getValue('sys_id');
            if (resSysId == assignedResId) {
                continue;
            }
            var eval_result = this._evaluateResource(resSysId, planned, requiredPerDay, po);
            if (eval_result.feasible) {
                candidates.push(eval_result);
            }
        }

        if (candidates.length === 0) {
            var reason = 'No feasible resource found.';
            if (assignedResId) {
                reason += ' Assigned resource was not feasible.';
            }
            reason += ' Checked all active, available resources with sufficient capacity.';
            return { success: false, error: reason };
        }

        candidates.sort(function (a, b) {
            var startCmp = a.planned_start.compareTo(b.planned_start);
            if (startCmp !== 0) return startCmp;
            return b.resource.capacity - a.resource.capacity;
        });

        var best = candidates[0];
        return {
            success: true,
            resource: best.resource,
            planned_start: best.planned_start,
            planned_end: best.planned_end,
            days_needed: best.days_needed,
            was_fallback: true
        };
    },

    /**
     * Evaluates whether a specific resource is feasible for the PO.
     */
    _evaluateResource: function (resSysId, planned, requiredPerDay, po) {
        var res = new GlideRecord(this.RES_TABLE);
        if (!res.get(resSysId)) {
            return { feasible: false, reason: 'Resource not found' };
        }

        var resName = res.getValue('resource_name');
        if (res.getValue('active') != '1') {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' is inactive' };
        }
        if (res.getValue('status') != 'available') {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' status: ' + res.getDisplayValue('status') };
        }
        if (res.getValue('maintenance_required') == '1' || res.getValue('maintenance_required') == 'true') {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' requires maintenance' };
        }

        var capacity = parseFloat(res.getValue('capacity_per_day')) || 0;
        if (capacity <= 0) {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' has zero capacity' };
        }
        if (requiredPerDay > 0 && requiredPerDay > capacity) {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' capacity ' + capacity + ' < required ' + requiredPerDay };
        }

        var daysNeeded = Math.ceil(planned / capacity);
        if (daysNeeded < 1) daysNeeded = 1;

        var slot = this._findEarliestSlot(resSysId, daysNeeded, po);
        if (!slot) {
            return { feasible: false, reason: resName + ' has no available slot (too many consecutive conflicts)' };
        }

        return {
            feasible: true,
            resource: { sys_id: resSysId, name: resName, capacity: capacity },
            planned_start: slot.start,
            planned_end: slot.end,
            days_needed: daysNeeded
        };
    },

    /**
     * Finds the earliest conflict-free time slot on a resource.
     */
    _findEarliestSlot: function (resSysId, daysNeeded, po) {
        var candidateStart = this._determineStartDate(po);
        var MAX_ITERATIONS = 50;

        for (var i = 0; i < MAX_ITERATIONS; i++) {
            var candidateEnd = new GlideDateTime(candidateStart);
            candidateEnd.addDaysLocalTime(daysNeeded);

            var conflict = new GlideRecord(this.SCHED_TABLE);
            conflict.addQuery('production_resource', resSysId);
            conflict.addQuery('active', true);
            conflict.addQuery('status', 'IN', 'draft,scheduled,confirmed,in_progress');
            conflict.addQuery('planned_start', '<', candidateEnd.getValue());
            conflict.addQuery('planned_end', '>', candidateStart.getValue());
            conflict.orderByDesc('planned_end');
            conflict.setLimit(1);
            conflict.query();

            if (!conflict.next()) {
                return { start: candidateStart, end: candidateEnd };
            }

            candidateStart = new GlideDateTime(conflict.getValue('planned_end'));
        }

        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Determines the base schedule start date from the PO.
     */
    _determineStartDate: function (po) {
        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var poStart = po.getValue('planned_start_date');

        if (poStart) {
            var poGdt = new GlideDateTime(poStart);
            if (poGdt.compareTo(now) > 0) {
                return poGdt;
            }
        }

        var tomorrow = new GlideDateTime();
        tomorrow.addDaysLocalTime(1);
        var tomorrowStr = tomorrow.getLocalDate().toString() + ' 08:00:00';
        return new GlideDateTime(tomorrowStr);
    },

    _fail: function (reason) {
        return { success: false, error: reason };
    },

    type: 'ProductionScheduler'
};
]]></script>
